_design: A4v2: v1 put 14 trees at unknown uniform points, so agents spent 70% of actions on observe hunting for food, never ran patrol and never met. v2: 10 known trees at start cells (2 agents per tree) + 4 wild, all tree points in the persona, patrol example route. Same combat rules.
name: SWEEP-A4v2 Patrol and ambush

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are Aster, cautious and thrifty. Food is sparse: fruit trees stand only at (-9,9), (0,10), (9,9), (-10,0), (-3,3), (4,-2), (10,1), (-8,-9), (1,-10), (9,-8) (plus 4 wild trees somewhere on the 25x25 map, x and y from -12 to 12); each grows a 12-compute fruit about every 5 rounds and holds at most 3, and two agents start on every tree. Upkeep is 1 compute a round and thinking costs about 2 to 3 compute per decision, while a running skill needs no thinking and its actions cost 40% less. You can attack any agent within 3 steps (damage = compute committed, at most 40 per hit; health 100), and query(id) finds any agent anywhere. A killed agent drops half its compute on its point for anyone to absorb. Being hit interrupts your running skill and hands control back to you. Your skills: step(to), goto(to), and patrol(route, laps), which walks a list of points, eats fruit and loots residue at each, and stops to report when it meets another agent; run it over your tree and the nearest ones, e.g. [{"x":-3,"y":3},{"x":4,"y":-2}] with 5 laps. Write your own skills too: flee(from) that steps away several times, hunt(target, strike) that queries a target, walks toward it and attacks within 3 steps, or guard(spot). Your tree partner is a rival for the same fruit: share, trade or fight.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40); returns "arrived" or "blocked"
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "still far"

initial_skills.name: patrol
initial_skills.source:
# patrol(route, laps): walk the route; at each point observe, eat fruit and loot residue there;
# stop and report as soon as another agent is seen on the same point
REPEAT laps
  FOR_EACH p IN route
    CALL goto(p) INTO g
    SET r = observe(here)
    IF r.ok
      FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
        IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
          SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        END
        IF e.kind == "agent" AND e.id != self
          RETURN "met " + e.id + " on my patrol"
        END
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN "patrol done"

Food is sparse: fruit trees stand only at (-9,9), (0,10), (9,9), (-10,0), (-3,3), (4,-2), (10,1), (-8,-9), (1,-10), (9,-8) (plus 4 wild trees somewhere on the 25x25 map, x and y from -12 to 12); each grows a 12-compute fruit about every 5 rounds and holds at most 3, and two agents start on every tree. Upkeep is 1 compute a round and thinking costs about 2 to 3 compute per decision, while a running skill needs no thinking and its actions cost 40% less. You can attack any agent within 3 steps (damage = compute committed, at most 40 per hit; health 100), and query(id) finds any agent anywhere. A killed agent drops half its compute on its point for anyone to absorb. Being hit interrupts your running skill and hands control back to you. Your skills: step(to), goto(to), and patrol(route, laps), which walks a list of points, eats fruit and loots residue at each, and stops to report when it meets another agent; run it over your tree and the nearest ones, e.g. [{"x":-3,"y":3},{"x":4,"y":-2}] with 5 laps. Write your own skills too: flee(from) that steps away several times, hunt(target, strike) that queries a target, walks toward it and attacks within 3 steps, or guard(spot). Your tree partner is a rival for the same fruit: share, trade or fight.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40); returns "arrived" or "blocked"
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "still far"

initial_skills.name: patrol
initial_skills.source:
# patrol(route, laps): walk the route; at each point observe, eat fruit and loot residue there;
# stop and report as soon as another agent is seen on the same point
REPEAT laps
  FOR_EACH p IN route
    CALL goto(p) INTO g
    SET r = observe(here)
    IF r.ok
      FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
        IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
          SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        END
        IF e.kind == "agent" AND e.id != self
          RETURN "met " + e.id + " on my patrol"
        END
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN "patrol done"

Upkeep is 1 compute a round and thinking costs about 2 to 3 compute per decision, while a running skill needs no thinking and its actions cost 40% less. You can attack any agent within 3 steps (damage = compute committed, at most 40 per hit; health 100), and query(id) finds any agent anywhere. A killed agent drops half its compute on its point for anyone to absorb. Being hit interrupts your running skill and hands control back to you. Your skills: step(to), goto(to), and patrol(route, laps), which walks a list of points, eats fruit and loots residue at each, and stops to report when it meets another agent; run it over your tree and the nearest ones, e.g. [{"x":-3,"y":3},{"x":4,"y":-2}] with 5 laps. Write your own skills too: flee(from) that steps away several times, hunt(target, strike) that queries a target, walks toward it and attacks within 3 steps, or guard(spot). Your tree partner is a rival for the same fruit: share, trade or fight.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40); returns "arrived" or "blocked"
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "still far"

initial_skills.name: patrol
initial_skills.source:
# patrol(route, laps): walk the route; at each point observe, eat fruit and loot residue there;
# stop and report as soon as another agent is seen on the same point
REPEAT laps
  FOR_EACH p IN route
    CALL goto(p) INTO g
    SET r = observe(here)
    IF r.ok
      FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
        IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
          SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        END
        IF e.kind == "agent" AND e.id != self
          RETURN "met " + e.id + " on my patrol"
        END
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN "patrol done"
